issues.title: As a player I wish to Cancel creating a message
issues.body:
Once a message is being created in a channel, it is possible to collapse the message using the down arrow in the header bar:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/126497480-ff85ef6a-b360-4147-85f1-9abbbd03f821.png)


But, it would also be useful to have a `Cancel` button down by the `Send Message` button.  There are some weird UI layout issues where we can't see the top of the message, and are stuck.  These individual issues need to be identified/fixed, but the presence of a `Cancel` button would provide a temporary workaround.
